A '''dehumidifier'''<ref name="SD">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Shintel Downtime|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> or '''dehumidifying unit''' was a device designed to maintain the humidity within a building. The homes at the [[Krevk Settlement]] on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] were equipped with dehumidifiers,<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|14|The Breath of Gelgelar}}</ref> as were the meeting halls at [[Imperial Depot 4290-1]] on [[Shintel]].<ref name="SD" />
